'''Testville''' is a fictional city used only in automated tests. It has a palace, a lake and a busy market, and this sentence exists to make the lead long enough.

==Understand==
===Climate===
Testville is warm from March to May and wet from June to September, with mild winters that most visitors find pleasant for walking.

==Get in==
===By train===
Testville Junction has daily trains to the state capital. The journey takes about three hours and tickets sell out at weekends.

==Get around==
Auto-rickshaws are everywhere and usually refuse the meter, so agree a fare before you start any journey.

===By bus===
City buses leave from the central bus stand every few minutes and cover most of the sights described below.

==Eat==
Testville is known for the '''Testville Pak''', a sweet made from gram flour and ghee.

* '''Bisi Test Bath''' - Rice and lentils cooked with local spices, served hot in most restaurants.
* '''Kafe Example''' - Opposite the bus stand, a small restaurant with good coffee.

==Stay safe==
Testville is generally safe, but watch your belongings in the crowded market area during festival weeks.

==Respect==
Remove your shoes before entering temples and ask before photographing people at prayer.
